Audio Forge includes support for local speech transcription using the
ihnatov-yuri/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-uk automatic speech recognition model.

Attribution:
Yuri Ihnatov (https://ihnatov.nl), fine-tuned from NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 (CC BY 4.0)

Model repository:
https://huggingface.co/ihnatov-yuri/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-uk

Base model:
https://huggingface.co/nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3
